newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Resources Devt in JV with Sin Heng Chan.
newsitem.headline: Resources Devt in JV with Sin Heng Chan.

text.p: Building supplies company Resources Development Corp Ltd (RDC) said on Thursday it had agreed to invest a total of Singapore $17.64 million in a joint venture to handle and distribute cement.
The company said in a statement it would pay Malaysian feedmiller Sin Heng Chan (1960) Ltd S$7.35 million for a 49 percent stake in its unit Sing Heng Chan (Singapore) Pte Ltd.

It would pay a further S$10.29 million to Sin Heng Chan as a contribution towards the cost of modifying's the joint venture's buildings and facilities in Jurong, west Singapore, which were previously used for grain handling.
"The board of directors believes that the investment in the cement business will provide excellent synergy for RDC's ready-mixed concrete business," it said.
The company added that the investment would be paid out of internal resources and by bank borrowings.
It was not expected to have a material impact on the earnings per share and net tangible assets per share of the company for the financial year ending December 31, 1997.
